tools.name: learn_answer
tools.description: Finds AstroCalc's plain-language guide chapters that answer a general question about Indian (Vedic) astrology, e.g. "what is Manglik dosha", "is 24 gunas enough", "what is Nadi dosha", "Saturn in the 7th house", "how do dashas work", "what is Sade Sati". tools.description: Finds a city or town and its coordinates, Indian places ranked first, from the same city list AstroCalc's kundli form uses.
